purpose: I1.  Characterise the ADDENDUM 16.1 extension surface over the four waves that ran it, rather than re-reporting a per-wave rank correlation whose sample changes every wave.  Reads only committed artifacts.

reproduction_control.verdict: REPRODUCIBLE: every repeated child scores identically and holds the identical prompt set across the wave boundary, so a change in rho is a change in the POPULATION and not in the instrument

per_wave.verdict: not estimable: an empty conditional pool

expected_rho_null.note: The null holds the INSTRUMENT fixed at its behaviour on the other three waves and varies only the population.  A wave whose observed rho sits inside its own null needs no explanation beyond who it measured.
